articles.title: Do You Need a Measles Booster Shot?
articles.summary: Most people do not need a measles booster, doctors say, but some groups should check their shots.

articles.title: Three Leaders, One First: Trump, Xi and Putin Meet
articles.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia held their first-ever three-way meeting and promised talks on nuclear weapons.

articles.title: UK and EU Close to a Deal for Young Travellers
articles.summary: The UK and EU are expected to agree a youth mobility scheme letting young people work and travel more easily.
